subject: Offer structure proposal for Samira Khan — contractor → FTE conversion
messages:
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Samira Khan conversion compensation

Hi team,

I've been discussing Samira Khan (currently engaged via HiringSolutions LLC as a senior inference engineer) for conversion to FTE starting 8/16. She's been running the inference kernel optimization work on our Dedicated backlog and the team's feedback is excellent.

Summary proposal (manager ask):
- Level: Senior IC (mapped to Band 4)
- Base salary: $175,000 annual
- Sign-on / conversion bonus: $10,000 one-time (to offset vendor transition and retention)
- Equity: 0.06% RSU grant (4-year vest, 1y cliff)
- Target start: 2026-08-16 (needs final docuSign by 7/23)

Rationale: her ramp is effectively zero, critical for the A/B rollout of the KV-cache work, and losing her would delay two sprints of launchable infra. Budget impact: within hiring bar for Band 4 in west coast markets but above midpoint; asking HR/Finance to review and approve the $10k sign-on. I've attached a draft offer and the comp band mapping.

Attachments: offer_letter_draft.pdf, comp_band_mapping.xlsx

Next steps: can HR confirm band placement and total comp band position? Finance to confirm headcount/budget availability for FY26 Q4. If approvals are aligned, Marissa will send the formal offer to Samira.

Thanks,
Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Samira Khan conversion compensation

Thanks for the context, Rohan. I reviewed the comp band file. A few notes:

1) Band placement: Band 4 is appropriate given scope and impact. However the base of $175k sits above the 60th percentile for Band 4 in our comp bands for SF/Oakland. We'll need a short written justification for benchmark deviation — please provide examples of peer comps or revenue impact.

2) Sign-on: $10k is permissible but we generally expect sign-ons >$7.5k to be reserved for critical retention cases. Please confirm if this is critical retention vs. standard conversion bonus.

3) Headcount: We have an open headcount for "Senior Engineer — Inference" on the org chart. Finance alignment / SLT notification required for any above-midpoint offers.

I can provisionally approve Band 4 placement and the base pending the justification. cc'ing Mina to coordinate the approvals doc and capture the rationale for the file HR needs.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Samira Khan conversion compensation

Laura / Rohan — thanks for the packet.

Finance notes: the headcount exists and we have budgeted FTE capacity in Q4 for this role, so base salary as proposed is fundable. That said, given comp band position above midpoint and the precedent of vendor-to-FTE conversions, would request we split the sign-on into a $5k immediate conversion bonus + $5k retention payout at 6 months (onboarding/retention contingent). This reduces near-term cash pressure and aligns incentives.

Please update the offer letter to reflect a two-part bonus and include a short justification memo (1 paragraph) referencing the latency of current projects. If HR signs off, Finance will provide formal OK and procurement should be copied for vendor offboarding paperwork.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samira.Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, HiringSolutions LLC <recruiting@hiringsolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer and next steps (verbal preview)

Hi Samira — quick note to share the high-level verbal offer before we send the formal docs:

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (FTE) — Band 4
- Base: $175,000
- Bonus: $5,000 conversion now + $5,000 retention at 6 months
- Equity: 0.06% RSU grant
- Start: target 2026-08-16

We expect to share the formal offer via DocuSign by Friday pending final signatures from HR and Finance. Please reply with any constraints on that start date or questions on the breakdown.

Samira replied (cc'd HiringSolutions): "Appreciate the clarity — acceptance pending written offer. 8/16 works for me. Appreciate the sign-on structure."

Attachment: none in this message (formal docs pending).

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Final approvals & docs: Samira Khan offer (ready for signature)

Team — thanks for the back-and-forth. Per notes: Laura has provisionally approved Band 4; Aditya approved budget conditional on two-part sign-on. Rohan has provided justification (attached). I've compiled the approvals memo and updated the offer letter to reflect the $5k + $5k structure and added an onboarding retention clause.

Attached: offer_letter_draft.pdf (final), comp_band_mapping.xlsx (annotated), comp_approvals_signoff.docx (Laura + Aditya signoff placeholders)

Action items:
- Laura: can you add your formal sign-off in comp_approvals_signoff.docx?
- Aditya: please confirm final OK on the two-part payout so procurement can offboard HiringSolutions and we can route to DocuSign.
- Marissa: once we get the two internal sign-offs, please send the DocuSign link to Samira and copy procurement (procure@acmeops.com) to start vendor offboarding.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded/xyz-offer-1234

If possible, please complete sign-offs today — Samira is expecting the formal offer before Friday and a quick start will avoid losing momentum.

Thanks,
Mina

Rohan
